title: Cat Sculpture Assembly
description: A large, geometric polygonal cat constructed from colorful faceted panels stands partially assembled on wooden scaffolding. In the foreground, a small grey polygonal human figure sits on planks, connected by thin red wires to the massive cat structure against a solid black background.
prompt: A large abstract geometric cat made of brightly colored polygonal panels in yellow, purple, teal, pink and red, partially built on wooden scaffolding and metal supports. A small faceted grey human figure sits in the foreground on wooden planks, manipulating red wires connected to the giant cat structure. Dramatic lighting, clean black background, detailed textures on wood and metal, surreal art style.
